title: Content locale
description: Translation of the player-facing content texts into one language (D-061), content/<region>/i18n/<lang>.json. A flat map from text key to text; English is the source in the main content files and has no locale file. Keys are "<file>.<id>.<field>" (buildings.lumberjack.name, quests.q01.text, islands.large.name) or "<file>.<index>" for list entries (island_names.12, zero-based). A shipped language must have every key; the loader reports missing and unknown keys.
